title: feat(pre-pr): run every gate and one CodeRabbit CLI review before a PR opens, and block PRs that skip it
body:
Dave is building a Software Factory that will open many more PRs, and every CCv3 PR opens as one CodeRabbit identity: Team allows 8 PR reviews an hour, slowing to 6/4/2/1 as the 7-day count passes 40/50/60/70. So our own checks and one CodeRabbit CLI review must run before a PR opens, and each PR should need about 2 PR reviews. This PR adds that gate, the hook that enforces it, the review-budget rules Dave adopted (A), and pr_watch handling for CodeRabbit limits and missing proof (B).

## What changed

- `scripts/github/pre-pr.mjs` (new): requires a clean, non-main branch not behind `main` or `fork/main`; runs the AGENTS.md gates for each changed surface and NOTEs unowned paths; checks the Evidence block with review-status's own parser (GREEN must name the head); runs `cr review --agent --committed --base <base>` once per head behind a free `cr usage --agent` preflight, a run lock and a 2-run cap shared across worktrees; parses the NDJSON by the documented fields and PASSes only on a `complete` event; kills the whole process tree on timeout (no `taskkill /T`). On a full pass it writes a stamp keyed by the head.
- `.claude/hooks/src/pre-pr-gate.ts` (new, + dist): PreToolUse on Bash and PowerShell denies `gh pr create` and `gh api .../pulls` POST (continued lines too) for this repo unless a stamp under 24h names the current and pushed head, the body file matches, and any CodeRabbit skip is an accepted reason: `cli-missing`, `cap` after at least one PASS run, or `rate-limited` with a wait. Fails open on internal errors; Dave-only `SKIP_PRE_PR_GATE=1`, logged. Registered in `settings.json.template` only.
- `pr-opened-review-loop.ts`: shared continued-line joining and endpoint-only `/pulls` matching (no false deny on a comment that names `/pulls`).
- `review-status.mjs`: `coderabbitRateLimited`, `coderabbitRetryMinutes`. ccv3-mods `pr-loop`: a PROOF state and rate-limit wording that says check `@coderabbitai rate limit` (free), never post a review while limited. A sync test keeps the mod's reason text equal to review-status.
- `pr-review-loop.md`: "Before you open a PR", the per-class review budget (docs 0, normal 1+1, steering/infra/r3 1+2), known limits, and the stale `coderabbit-guard` claim fixed.

Built by a Sonnet kraken in 4 rounds against 4 Opus critic passes (FIX, FIX, FIX, SHIP).

## Evidence

Proof type: feature

RED: `node --test scripts/github/pre-pr.test.mjs` @ 9e537140
```text
# Error [ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND]: Cannot find module '...\scripts\github\pre-pr.mjs' imported from ...\scripts\github\pre-pr.test.mjs
# tests 1
# fail 1
```

GREEN: `node --test scripts/github/pre-pr.test.mjs` @ 10514ebf
```text
# tests 96
# pass 96
# fail 0
```

The real gate runs found false FAILs that test doubles could not show. Run 1 (7ec8d7f3): a 5-minute timeout on the 14-minute github suite, a load-only failure in a timer test, and `mods-validate` failing whenever tsc cannot run (Claude Code 2.1.296+ writes no plugin types); fixed tests-first in 2e7fbf0d (RR1-RR5). Run 2 (2e7fbf0d): a dist-integration hook test passed vitest's 5 s default under the full parallel load; fixed in f4514d88 (RR6), full hooks suite with the gate's flags 106 of 106 files, 2795 tests. Run 3 (f4514d88): every gate passed and the gate's first real `cr review --agent --committed --base main` gave 7 findings (5 distinct, all real: the run cap reset on a merge of main, a sub-15-minute CLI time limit, two long rule sentences, fail-open on a recognised PR create, an empty PROOF problem list). Fixed tests-first in d2403f31 (20 of 20 mutations killed). The cap key changed in that commit, so the earlier CLI run is not counted against this branch. Run 4 (d2403f31): every gate passed; the second CLI review gave 2 findings: a Bash backslash-newline split inside a word (`gh a\` + `pi`) hid a PR create from the hook (fixed in 830cb4cf: join per shell, match if either reading is a create), and a rebase still starts a new CLI run count (reduced: git:behind now says merge, and nam
